[P2] Apply submitter-message matching to nested wrapper links

The empty-message workaround only runs for execution errors. If `wait_for_callback` runs inside another child context and its submitter raises `PaymentError()`, the callback context retains `StepError` with message `""`, while the outer context checkpoints `CallbackSubmitterError` with message `"Callback submitter failed"`. `_links()` cannot match those keys, so the outer context and execution report `CallbackSubmitterError` while the submitter and callback context report `PaymentError`. Move this equivalence into shared cause matching used by `_links()` too, and add nested live/replay coverage.
